_note: Vocabulary = terms that should NOT appear in KSA school content. Step 1: Find these in the PDF. Step 2: Run violation check on each found keyword.

Religious Compliance.description: Align with Islamic values. Prohibit promotion of other religions, atheism, or inappropriate religious symbols.

Political Neutrality.description: Strict political neutrality. Prohibit content related to unauthorized political activism or ideologies.

Public Safety & Morality.description: Prohibit violence, weapons, terrorism, or illegal substances (alcohol/drugs).

Social & Cultural Values.description: Respect KSA social norms. Prohibit sexual content, LGBTQ+ promotion, or Western-specific celebrations.
